name: CF RA200
description: Alembic F-2B tube preamp (two 12AX7 stages, Fender AB763 stack, bright) into a pair of Yamaha RA-200 rotating-speaker cabinets: crossover, three rotating speakers per cabinet (Doppler and directivity), four fixed 12-inch, one mic per cabinet: stereo out. Gilmour's 1979 rig, the path beside the Hiwatts. State in the slot work buffer. TEST: rotor speeds and crossover are starting values; cost not yet measured on the pedal.

params.name: Volume
params.explanation: F-2B 1M volume (audio taper): drive into the second 12AX7 and level.

params.name: Bright
params.explanation: F-2B bright switch (120 pF across the volume).

params.name: Speed
params.explanation: RA-200 slow rotor speed, 0.4..3 Hz (the hardware's tremolo speed knob).

params.name: Rotor
params.explanation: 0 off (all to the fixed speakers), 1 slow, 2 fast (6.6 Hz, fixed); the rotors spin up and down.
